calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-29-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
Petitioners Quang Binh Tran and Nu Kiet Nguy; father and mother of minors present in court.
Petitioners sworn and examined through Cantonese Interpreter Kandice Nhu Tran/daughter.
Proof of Publication on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor 1. from Nhu Bui Tran to Kandice Nhu Tran. The court also grants the petition for Change of Name of minor 2. from Vinh Chi Tran, aka Jacson Vinh Chi Tran to Jacson Vinh Tran. The court also grants the Petition for Change of Name of Nu Kiet Nguy/mother to Sunny Nguy Tran.
Decree Changing Names signed in open court.
